explanation: The SARFAESI Act was enacted in 2002 to allow banks to auction residential or commercial properties of defaulters to recover loans.
Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1), Additional Tier 1, and Retained Earnings form Tier 1 Capital. Subordinated debt is part of Tier 2 Capital.
Government of India issues Treasury Bills for three tenors: 91 days, 182 days, and 364 days. The shortest is 91 days.
